title: Wanderer above the Sea of Fog (Caspar David Friedrich)
moodDescription: German Romantic sublime contemplation; solitary reflection gazing over an infinite sea of swirling mountain mist

regions.label: The Solitary Wanderer
regions.spokenLabel: A lone traveler in a dark green frock coat standing resolute on the precipice, back turned, hair stirred by the mountain wind.
regions.timbreDescription: Solo melancholic English horn & expressive cello

regions.label: Rocky Summit Crag
regions.spokenLabel: The jagged, weathered volcanic rock mass thrusting upward through the clouds, anchoring the wanderer's stance.

regions.label: The Swirling Sea of Fog
regions.spokenLabel: An ocean of dense, billowing white clouds rolling like phantom waves through the mountain valleys below.
regions.timbreDescription: Lowpass ambient choral mist & slow tape echo

regions.label: Distant Mountain Peaks
regions.spokenLabel: Silent mountain ranges in the far distance rising like islands through the mist into the pale sky.
regions.timbreDescription: Alpine French horns & serene brass swells

regions.label: Infinite Pale Sky
regions.spokenLabel: The pale, luminous atmosphere above, vast and serene, blending into infinite space.
regions.timbreDescription: High string harmonics and delicate glass bells
